description_en: Queries all buckets of a user
description_zh: 调用ListBuckets查询指定用户拥有的所有存储空间（Bucket）
name: ListBuckets

parameters.help_en: The prefix that returned bucket names must contain. If this parameter is not specified, prefix information will not be used as a filter
parameters.help_zh: 限定返回的bucket name必须以prefix作为前缀。可以不设定该参数，不设定时则不过滤前缀信息
parameters.name: prefix

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of returned buckets. You can leave this parameter empty. The default value is 10. The value cannot be greater than 100
parameters.help_zh: 限定此次返回bucket的最⼤数。可以不设定该参数，不设定时默认值为10，取值不能⼤于100
parameters.name: page_size
